memory_candidates.content: In this repo's /orchestrate pipeline, skill_postflight_update's 'monotonic-max' status-regression clamp (scripts/skill-base.sh) reads its 'current status' comparator LIVE from specs/state.json at postflight call time. Because skill_preflight_update (called first, in the same process, moments before dispatch) unconditionally overwrites state.json's status to the phase's in-progress variant with NO clamp of its own, the postflight clamp ends up comparing against the value its own round's preflight just wrote -- not the task's true pre-round status. This is invisible for already-shipped forced-phase use cases (forcing a phase whose target rank happens to be forward of the task's ordinary resting rank), but breaks for the highest-ranked statuses (completed, rank 7) where forcing research/plan resolves to a lower rank that reads as 'not a regression' against the preflight-corrupted comparator, causing a permanent downgrade. Any future work on forced-phase status handling must add an equivalent clamp to skill_preflight_update, not just skill_postflight_update.
